## Question

## Question
What is the correct sequence of steps for perivitelline space microinjection?

## Options
  A. 1. Manually adjust injection plate position to place embryos in diagonal orientation for precise needle insertion
2. Transfer approximately 10 anesthetized embryos at two to three days post-fertilization onto flat injecting plate coated with 1% agarose
3. Arrange embryo positions with hair loop tool to orient embryos in same direction
4. Direct needle tip at injection site and gently insert into perivitelline space between yolk sac and epidermis of zebrafish embryo
5. Inject approximately 400 mCherry-labeled tumor cells while avoiding yolk sac rupture to prevent misplaced implantation
